findings.explanation:
Credit note test-credit (USD 8,000.00) shows no application to INV-A and no ledger reduction
Credit note record test-credit (amountCents 800000, date 2026-10-26, invoiceId invoice-0) carries evidenceId test-credit-document. The extraction of test-credit-document (issued-credit.pdf) states Type: credit_note, Invoice: INV-A, Currency: USD, AmountCents: 800000, Date: 2026-10-26. The bundle contains no credit-note application record, and no ledger entry references test-credit: the only revenue-side postings are entry-invoice-0 (accounts_receivable debit 2000000 / service_revenue credit 2000000, sourceReference doc-inv-0) and opening. No ledger line reduces accounts_receivable.
A credit note of 800000 cents against INV-A exists in the creditNotes table with a supporting extraction, but accounts_receivable remains 2000000 cents and service_revenue remains 2000000 cents with no credit posting. The stated credit amount is therefore unapplied.
A human should confirm with the credit-note approval record whether test-credit was validly issued, then verify whether a credit application to INV-A was ever posted. No netting or adjustment is performed here.

No bank receipt or statement evidence exists for the USD 20,000.00 receivable on INV-A
The bundle receipts array is empty (0 records). Invoice-0 (INV-A, Aster Advisory, amountCents 2000000, issueDate 2026-10-01, dueDate 2026-11-01, expectedDate 2026-10-28) is supported by doc-inv-0, whose extraction restates the same amount and dates. Ledger entry entry-invoice-0 (sourceReference doc-inv-0) debits accounts_receivable 2000000 and credits service_revenue 2000000. The bundle's evidence array contains only doc-inv-0 (invoice) and test-credit-document (credit note): no bank receipt, remittance advice, deposit slip or bank statement is supplied for the business.
The unmatched-receipt check cannot be completed in either direction: there is no receipt record to match to an invoice, and no receipt evidence exists to substantiate collection of the 2000000 cents receivable. The expectedDate of 2026-10-28 for INV-A is unsupported by any collection evidence in the bundle.
A human should obtain the bank statement covering the period from the business start date and compare it to invoice-0; if nothing has been received, record the receivable as outstanding without writing anything off.

Opening ledger entry cites sourceReference doc-ledger, which is absent from the bundle
Ledger entry opening (effectiveDate 2026-10-01) records cash debit 2000000 and opening_equity credit 2000000, with sourceReference doc-ledger. No evidence record with id doc-ledger exists: the bundle's evidence array contains only doc-inv-0 and test-credit-document. The other ledger entry, entry-invoice-0, does resolve to its document (doc-inv-0).
The 2000000 cents of opening cash and opening equity rest on a referenced document that is not in the bundle, so the opening balance cannot be traced to a supplied source. Amount is deliberately not carried into amount_flagged_usd: the finding is the absent document, not a disputed balance.
A human should supply the opening-balance document referenced as doc-ledger and confirm it agrees to the cash and opening_equity postings. No entry is posted or amended here.

Dates disagree: business startDate 2026-10-26, but the opening entry and invoice are dated 2026-10-01
business.startDate is 2026-10-26 (timezone America/Los_Angeles). Ledger entry opening has effectiveDate 2026-10-01 and ledger entry entry-invoice-0 has effectiveDate 2026-10-01. Invoice-0 is stated with issueDate 2026-10-01 in the invoice record and again in the doc-inv-0 extraction (IssueDate: 2026-10-01). The credit note is dated 2026-10-26, which matches startDate.
Three records place activity (opening balance, invoice issuance, revenue recognition) 25 days before the bundle's declared business startDate. Either the startDate is a data-entry error or the 2026-10-01 postings belong to a prior period that the bundle does not define. The conflicting values are quoted and not resolved. No amount is attached because the conflict concerns dates, not money.
A human should confirm the intended fiscal period start date and whether the 2026-10-01 postings are opening balances carried forward. No dates are amended in the bundle.
